posts.description: I won’t buy GTA 6. I won’t play it. And I haven’t played video games in years. I say this as a former gamer, and a pretty hardcore one. posts.title: SO-101: after 40 demonstrations it grabs it. And the green cube? | Ep. 3 Training
posts.description: Third episode of the series on the SO-101 robotic arm. In the second one I showed it the task only 10 times, and it got really close without making it. This time there are 40 demonstrations. 40 demonstrations, red and yellow I guided the arm by hand 40 times, with two cubes: a red one and a yellow one. Then I let it go on its own.
